fishing: WHEN: Fri Nov 13 mild fall; solid inshore bite continues with abundant bait and lower water helping some spots. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, whiting, pompano, sheepshead, flounder, Spanish near Englewood Beach / Manasota / Stump Pass / Gasparilla on live shrimp, paddletails, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish strong under mangroves, oysters and mullet schools; snook, trout, flounder, sheepshead on docks/flats; shrimp/spoons/pinfish working. NEARSHORE: cobia, snapper, tripletail, bonita, kingfish in 40-50+ ft when seas allow; keeper red grouper deeper. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Fishin Franks 11/13 (reds/snook/trout/sheepshead/pompano/kings), FL Sportsman SW low-water reds/snappers with abundant bait, local guides.
redtide: FWC Nov 6 status: K. brevis background only in one Pinellas sample past week in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota. Recent samples not present/background. Next report due Nov 13.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples Nov 2-3). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2-6, Sarasota ~2-149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
